theme: Releases authored from the repository only
summary: Admin → Releases has been removed; releases are now authored only through the repository changelog files and shown in the Change Log Hub.
detailed_changes: Removed the Admin → Releases screens and their create, edit and delete actions, along with the Releases link in the admin sidebar. Nobody can change release notes from the admin panel any more (#385, #386).

Releases are written as changelog/releases/vX.Y.Z.json files in a pull request and loaded into the Change Log Hub by the sync that runs on every deploy. A published release is corrected by editing its file and deploying (#388).
The public Change Log Hub and the footer version link work as before (#387).
affected_areas: Page or route: /admin/releases (removed), /change-log-hub, footer version link
User groups affected: admins and super admins
Public impact: none; the Change Log Hub and footer version are unchanged
Internal impact: admin sidebar, admin routes, release authoring docs
